name: brandsync-web-components
description: Monorepo for Brandsync's design system: @brandsync/wc (web components), @brandsync/react, and @brandsync/angular wrappers.

scripts.build:all: npm run build -w packages/wc && npm run build -w packages/react -w packages/angular
scripts.build-storybook:all: npm run build:all && npm run build-storybook -w packages/wc && npm run build-storybook -w packages/react-storybook && npm run build-storybook -w packages/angular-storybook
